decision_rationale: This is a gene-essentiality prediction workflow that wraps a pre-trained protein language model and GNN classifier rather than proposing a new foundation model. The cited ESM-2 component is genuinely generative and broadly pretrained, but it is used as an external model inside an application pipeline.
evidence_snippet: “employs a pre-trained language model ESM-2”; “ESM-2 was trained on > 180 million proteins ... by solving the task of filling in randomly masked amino acids”,
